name: Seikishi Melty ☆ Lovers
source:
In Ederant, the greatest honour regardless of gender is becoming a knight. Till enrolled in the knight-training school Equites and must find a partner for the knight examination. He met the smart but naive Sefi, the motivated cool beauty Frey, the mysterious gun-toting Lil, and the foreign giant sword-wielding Canon. His pure admiration of knights would soon change into a greater wish due to these girls with the same aspirations.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/09/01/september-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

From the same staff as [url=https://vndb.org/v12599]Juukishi Cutie ☆ Bullet[/url]. People who have bought the title can trade the game with Seikishi Melty ☆ Lovers for free.
translation:
在埃德兰特，无论性别，成为骑士都是至高无上的荣誉。蒂尔进入骑士培训学校Equites就读，并必须为骑士考试寻找搭档。他遇到了聪明却天真的塞菲、干劲十足的冷艳美人弗蕾、神秘的持枪少女莉尔，以及挥舞巨剑的异国少女卡农。由于这些怀抱相同志向的女孩，他对骑士的单纯憧憬很快变成了更大的愿望。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/09/01/september-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

制作团队与[url=https://vndb.org/v12599]《Juukishi Cutie ☆ Bullet》[/url]相同。购买过该作的玩家可以免费将游戏兑换为《Seikishi Melty ☆ Lovers》。
